lines.explanation: Agent retrieved #random members (matching the referent set exactly) and the full users.list roster (matching the 19-user referent set), and reported both to the user.

Agent correctly resolved U_ROBERT (Robert Chen), checked his profile (no admin/title) and #engineering membership (absent), and accurately reported this discrepancy alongside the distinct Robert Walsh.

The CDN/content-delivery discussion resolves to #product-growth (C_GROWTH), which contains the Tokyo CDN-routing/CloudFront conversation. The agent never opened C_GROWTH's history and instead cited a #project-alpha message as 'the' CDN discussion, then asserted no CDN content exists elsewhere. This substitutes an unrelated/unverified source for the resolved referent channel and misses the actual seeded CDN conversation, so obligation 4 is demonstrated_incorrect despite the agent delivering an answer.
Agent queried conversations.history on the correctly resolved #project-alpha channel (C05ALPHA) and reported the returned discussion content to the user, satisfying the channel-reference obligation.

Agent checked #project-alpha-dev membership (C06ALPHADEV), correctly found Artem Bogdanov (U02ARTEM23) absent, and declined to call conversations.kick, reporting the discrepancy instead of removing an unrelated user. Both the user and channel referents were correctly used.
Agent checked #core-infra membership (C_INFRA), correctly found Hubert Marek (U06HUBERT23) absent, and declined to kick him, reporting the discrepancy. Both referents were correctly used.
Agent posted a streaming-infrastructure progress update to the correctly resolved #core-infra channel (C_INFRA).
Agent updated the topic of the correctly resolved #core-infra channel to reflect the virtual festival/CDN focus.

Card 9 (which message to delete) is underspecified with six competing candidates. The action is inactive per rule 4. The agent searched the actor's own messages, found none matching a festival/CDN description, declined to delete any of the six candidates, and asked the user to specify — correct ambiguity handling without unilaterally choosing.

Card 10 (which prior update to correct) is underspecified with five competing candidates. The action is inactive per rule 4. The agent again declined to edit any of the actor's messages and asked for the specific update to correct, which is correct handling of the unresolved choice.

assessment_issue.description: The trajectory's conversations.history call for #project-alpha (C05ALPHA, step 9) returns messages (including a CDN/edge-node message attributed to Robert Chen) that do not appear anywhere in the supplied 'Complete initial state' message list for that channel (which shows zero seeded messages in C05ALPHA). This creates a factual conflict between the packet's initial_state (used as the test-world ground truth) and the recorded tool observation. The assessment of lines 3 and 4 relies on the recorded trajectory content as given, but this inconsistency should be noted when interpreting the correctness of the agent's #project-alpha findings.
